Product Features

  • ELEGANT NEUTRAL GEOMETRIC LINE ART DESIGN: The white TV stand features a minimalist geometric pattern in neutral shades of white. Perfect for adding a modern and abstract touch to any room. This eye-catching line design combines a minimalist TV stand with abstract accents to create a sophisticated and stylish look, perfect for a stylish living area.
  • MINIMALISM: The simple, striped finish makes it a sophisticated choice for modern bohemian art. Thanks to its versatility, it fits a wide range of aesthetics, from mid-century to minimalist style.
  • The white minimalist TV stand brings modern mid-century glamour to your bedroom and living room. It can also be combined with other furniture in your home to create the perfect look.
  • MORE STORAGE SPACE: This TV stand features a pair of opening and closing cabinet doors that create extra large storage space and open shelves. You can adjust the storage space to suit your needs, either open for presentation or closed for storage. The powerful storage function meets your daily storage needs and keeps your home tidy.
  • TV cabinet size: 200*40*51cm, weight 30kg, can hold up to 90 inches TV
  • Sturdy Construction: Made of high-quality chipboard, this TV cabinet is sturdy, durable, and easy to clean.
  • It features cable organization control openings that allow for easy cable management and prevent messy cables from interfering with your entertainment system.
  • Easy installation: The TV cabinet comes with detailed instructions with all the accessories needed for installation, which can help you assemble the TV cabinet faster. If you have any problems with the product, please feel free to contact us.
  • 5 metal support feet ensure that the whole TV stand is stable, while the load is evenly distributed and not easily deformed.
  • The height of 14.5 cm above the ground allows the sweeper to drive through effortlessly. If you value quality, then we are the right choice for you.
